sources.snippet: We took Equinor’s massive 5GB open-source dataset of the decommissioned Huldra offshore rig and built a Level 4 Autonomous Spatial AI around it. This is not a cloud-dependent chatbot; it is a 100% sovereign, air-gapped, edge-computable Biomimetic Digital Twin powered by local open-source models and deterministic physics.
